[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Weeks 3-4: Building Endurance (3 runs/week)**  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Monday: 20-25 minute easy run

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Weeks 5-6: Building Speed and Endurance (3 runs/week)**  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Monday: 25-30 minute easy run with 10-15 minutes of brisk walking  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Wednesday: Interval training (20-30 minutes): Warm-up: 5 minutes easy run, 4-6 x 400m at a moderate pace (about 1-2 minutes), Cool-down: 5 minutes easy run  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Saturday: 35-40 minute easy run  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Weeks 7-8: Taper and Rest (2-3 runs/week)**  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Monday: 20-25 minute easy run  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Wednesday: Rest or cross-train (e.g., walk, bike, or swim)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Saturday: 20-25 minute easy run (reduce intensity and distance to rest your legs)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips provided for training:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Listen to your body: Rest when you need to, and don't push yourself too hard.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Gradually increase your mileage: Aim to increase your weekly mileage by no more than 10% each week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Incorporate proper warm-ups and cool-downs: Always warm up with 5-10 minutes of easy running or walking
